author: The Infographics Show
description:
A garage-built drone just shattered modern military doctrine by wiping out a multi-million-dollar armored column in seconds. In Ukraine, the frontline has become a rapid-fire weapons lab where low-cost FPV drones, fiber-optic links, and autonomous software make traditional mechanized warfare obsolete. But this battle isn’t just about contested borders, it’s an economic war of resource denial over critical minerals, where costly multi-million-dollar air defense missiles are being bankrupted by lawnmower engines.

We uncover how cheap technology broke modern warfare, and what happens when the global defense playbook becomes completely obsolete.

00:00 - How Drones Broke Modern War
01:26 - The Economic Shift in Drone Interception
02:35 - Armored Warfare is Dead
03:52 - Ukraine’s Wartime Tech Boom

07:40 - China’s Rare Earth Monopoly
11:00 - The Battle for Global Microchips

16:24 - Global Consequences and Stalemate
title: Why is War in Ukraine Still Happening?
